name: Brooklyn Bench Studio
tagline: A Williamsburg studio for meetups of 80 and hackathon weekends of 120, with power at every seat.
bio: I'm Rosa. We're a woodshop by day and an event space on evenings and weekends: long benches, good light, real Wi-Fi, a projector, and a roof deck in summer.
terms: Free to cancel up to 21 days before. Inside 21 days, 50%.
backupPlan: Our studio manager Eli is on site for every event.

experiences.name: Meetup evening
experiences.desc: The studio from 6 to 10pm for talks and drinks; we handle setup, AV and cleanup.
experiences.allIn: Venue, AV, staff, cleanup and tax. Food from our partners or your own caterer.

experiences.name: Hackathon weekend
experiences.desc: Saturday 9am to Sunday 6pm, benches with power for 120, a quiet room, overnight staff.
experiences.allIn: Venue, power, Wi-Fi, overnight staff, cleanup and tax.
experiences.av: Projector, mic, 1 Gbps Wi-Fi, power at every seat
